description: This file defines the StatCounter class used for tracking statistical measures (count, mean, variance, min, max) of a set of numbers, with support for merging and copying. It is part of Apache Spark's utility package.

classes.name: StatCounter
classes.description: A class for tracking statistical measures (count, mean, variance, min, max) of a set of numbers, with support for merging and copying.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Adds a value or another StatCounter into this one, updating internal statistics.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of this StatCounter with the same statistical data.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of values.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Returns the average of the values.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Returns the sum of all values.

methods.name: sampleVariance
methods.description: Returns the sample variance, correcting bias.

methods.name: popStdev
methods.description: Returns the population standard deviation (annotated with @Since 2.1.0).
